nodes.description: Mapping of account balances in ERC20.
Nested mapping of spender allowances in ERC20.
Total token supply tracked in ERC20.
Internal transfer that debits sender and credits recipient balances.
Internal mint that increases total supply and credits an account.
Internal burn that debits an account and decreases total supply.
Internal allowance setter that writes _allowances.
Public transfer that calls _transfer with _msgSender().
Public transferFrom that checks and decreases the caller allowance.
Public approve that calls _approve with _msgSender().
Increases the spender allowance by addedValue.
Decreases the spender allowance by subtractedValue.
Returns msg.sender as the execution context sender.
Caller-controlled address used as the transaction sender.

Constructor that forwards msg.value to the fee receiver via IPayable.pay.
External payable call to a deployer-supplied receiver address.

edges.reason: msg.sender is returned by Context._msgSender().
transfer passes _msgSender() as the sender to _transfer.
approve passes _msgSender() as owner to _approve.
transferFrom uses _msgSender() as the spender for the allowance check.
increaseAllowance uses _msgSender() as owner of the allowance.
decreaseAllowance uses _msgSender() as owner of the allowance.
SimpleERC20 constructor mints the initial balance to _msgSender().
transfer invokes _transfer.
approve invokes _approve.
transferFrom invokes _transfer.
transferFrom invokes _approve to reduce the allowance.
increaseAllowance invokes _approve with the combined value.
decreaseAllowance invokes _approve with the reduced value.
SimpleERC20 constructor calls _mint with initialBalance_.
SimpleERC20 constructor invokes the inherited ServicePayer constructor.
ServicePayer constructor forwards msg.value to the external receiver via pay().
The external receiver can re-enter the deploying contract while pay() executes.
_transfer reads the sender balance from _balances.
_transfer writes the updated sender and recipient balances to _balances.
_mint credits the account balance in _balances.
_mint increases _totalSupply.
_burn debits the account balance in _balances.
_burn decreases _totalSupply.
_approve writes the spender allowance into _allowances.
transferFrom reads the current allowance from _allowances.
decreaseAllowance reads the current allowance from _allowances.
currentAllowance local is loaded from _allowances in transferFrom.
accountBalance local is loaded from _balances in _burn.
sender parameter is used inside ERC20._transfer.
recipient parameter is used inside ERC20._transfer.
amount parameter is used inside ERC20._transfer.
senderBalance local is loaded from _balances in _transfer.
senderBalance is used for the balance require and balance update.
account parameter is used inside ERC20._mint.
spender parameter of approve is forwarded to _approve.
currentAllowance is used in the require and subtraction inside transferFrom.
accountBalance is used in the require and subtraction inside _burn.

normalization_plan.reason: The sender parameter only exists to feed ERC20._transfer and carries no independent semantics.
The recipient parameter only exists to feed ERC20._transfer and carries no independent semantics.
The amount parameter only exists to feed ERC20._transfer and carries no independent semantics.
senderBalance is a temporary cache used only inside ERC20._transfer.
The account parameter only exists to feed ERC20._mint and carries no independent semantics.
The spender parameter of approve is consumed by ERC20.approve/_approve and has no independent role.
currentAllowance is a temporary cache used only inside ERC20.transferFrom.
accountBalance is a temporary cache used only inside ERC20._burn.
